cited.quote: Satellite towns will be developed in sub-urban areas with modern amenities to decongest large cities
New Urban Development Authorities will be formed for Madurai, the Coimbatore - Tiruppur

rationale: C3 is the Governor's Address stating satellite towns will be developed (intent only). C5 is a GO constituting a Coimbatore urban development authority, and C4 an MRTS feasibility study; these are neighbouring planning steps, not creation of suburban areas with modern amenities near the listed cities.

cited.quote: candidates in waiting list of compassionate ground appointment for Junior Assistant/Typist

rationale: C1 concerns compassionate appointment for families of deceased police personnel, a different group. No extract shows a step for children of sanitary workers who die in service.

cited.quote: agitate against the farm laws and wish to present this before the assembly

rationale: C5 only dedicates the agriculture budget to farmers agitating against farm laws; no repeal, bill or GO appears. C1 deals with repeal of unrelated animal disease Acts.

cited.quote: coaching centres are being established across the State
conducting Coaching Classes for competitive examinations through separate channel for Education of Kalvi

rationale: C1 is a general policy-note statement. C5 is a GO sanctioning televised coaching on Kalvi Television, not coaching centres in the six named cities. No extract shows an official step to establish such centres.

cited.quote: form a new department called Water Resources Department
a separate Ministry for Water Resources has been established

rationale: C1 is G.O.Ms.No.13 (05.01.2022) separating the Water Resources wing from Public Works and forming a new department; C5 says a separate Ministry was established. The study mandate is not detailed but the new body exists alongside Public Works.

cited.quote: Transgender pension scheme, a monthly pension of Rs.1000/- is provided to

rationale: C1 (May 2022) still reports the monthly transgender pension at Rs.1000. No extract shows a GO or scheme raising it to Rs.1500.

cited.quote: special drive for rectification of errors in computerized land records of urban areas

rationale: C4 is a GO for error correction in urban land records and C1 reports a pilot of automatic patta transfer in two taluks; these are related record steps, not an order to issue pattas in urban areas.

cited.quote: Administrative Sanction is accorded for a sum of Rs.100.00 Crore
From 2021-2022 onwards Namakku Naame Thittam (NNT) is again implemented
will be implemented in rural areas during the year 2021-22 in 2,505 Village Panchayats

rationale: C1 and C2 show Namakku Naame Thittam revived by GO of 14.12.2021 with sanction. For Anna Marumalarchi, C3 only says AGAMT-II will be implemented in a policy note, with no GO shown. Only one of two schemes is evidenced.

cited.quote: if necessary Article 343 of the Constitution should be suitably amended

rationale: C1 is a Governor's Address statement that the Government will urge the Union to declare Tamil an official language and amend Article 343 if needed. This is intent, not a formal step such as a resolution or letter.

cited.quote: ongoing thermal projects on war 3 footing

rationale: C1 only says it is proposed to complete ongoing thermal projects on a war footing. C3 reports a mass maintenance directive to TANGEDCO, which is not an order to scale up generation and distribution capacity on a wartime basis.

cited.quote: works are under progress for erection of 104 5,692 Nos. of RMUs

rationale: C1 reports works under progress for Ring Main Units in Chennai and proposed substation schemes; C3 says capacity will be added over ten years. No extract shows a project commissioned, so work is under way but not operational.

cited.quote: to provide 50% input subsidy assistance to the DFFDA registered

rationale: C2 shows a 50% input subsidy for registered fish farmers and a 40% subsidy for GIFT culture, different from a 25% subsidy. No extract shows a 25% subsidy for the listed activities.
No extract shows the state urging the Union government to extend a scheme to municipalities. C2 and C3 concern state road funding and grants to municipalities.

No extract shows the state urging the Union government to give the National Commission for Backward Classes the authority of the Scheduled Castes commission. C4 and C5 mention the Commission only on law university admissions.

cited.quote: matters relating to pulses and all varieties of Dal

rationale: C4 only allocates subjects on pulses and dal among PDS officers (tur dal for Amma Unavagam). No extract shows a scheme to supply urad dal through ration shops.
No extract is about the Mannarkudi-Mathukkur-Pattukottai rail line. C1 mentions Mannargudi only for a drain; others concern Chennai metro.

cited.quote: Government issued orders for implementation of the Tamil Nadu Industrial Policy, 2021

rationale: C4 mentions the Industrial Policy 2021 GO dated 11.2.2021, before the government took office, and amends an electronics policy. C2 and C3 describe plans. No new policy on diversified, natural-resource-based industry is shown.

cited.quote: Develop and launch policy guidelines and implementation plans for industrial policies

rationale: C3 lists planned activities and C4 describes the long-standing Guidance agency. C5 is a regional planning rule. No new institutional mechanism for diversified, natural-resource-based industrial growth is shown.

cited.quote: vessels making industries, lock manufacturing and silk based industries

rationale: C2 is a GO (22.10.2021) adding lock and silk industries to thrust sectors eligible for 25% Special Capital Subsidy. Fireworks, mixers and grinders are not covered in any extract, so only part of the indicator is met.

cited.quote: To recommend measures needed to boost exports from MSMEs in the State

rationale: C3 is a GO forming a committee to recommend export measures and C2 describes proposed M-TIPB export support. These are plans or preparatory steps, not an announced export promotion package for MSME clusters.
